title: CoordinateSpace
description: Coordinate space registry (spec §4, §9, issue #9). Every coordinate MUST be tagged with one of these spaces so viewers can render overlays correctly across viewport sizes and device pixel ratios.

x-conversions.note: Conversion rules are non-normative here. See packages/sdk-python/src/augur_sdk/coordinates.py for the reference impl.
x-conversions.viewport_css_px<->device_px: multiply by device_scale_factor on the source observation
x-conversions.viewport_css_px<->screenshot_px: screenshots are captured at viewport scale by default; otherwise multiply by screenshot_scale
x-conversions.dom_client_rect: Diagnostic-only space. MUST be paired with provenance=dom. Never a runtime input (spec §4).
